params.name: ids
params.description: the IDs of the zones, mutually exclusive with id

params.name: available
params.description: True if you want to retrieve all available Zones. False if you only want to return the Zones from which you have at least one Instance. Default is false.

params.name: networktype
params.description: The Network type of the zone that the Instance belongs to

params.name: showcapacities

params.name: domainid
params.description: The ID of the domain associated with the zone

params.name: storageaccessgroup
params.description: the name of the storage access group

params.name: tags
params.description: List zones by resource tags (key/value pairs)

params.name: showicon
params.description: Flag to display the resource image for the zones
